proposed.sourceName: South African National Halaal Authority (SANHA) — E542 (Edible Bone Phosphate)
proposed.paraphrase: SANHA classifies E542 (edible bone phosphate) as Mushbooh (doubtful): it is derived from animal bones, so the animal source (pork/non-zabiha vs halal) must be verified before it can be considered permissible.

researcherNote: E542 seeded hanafiStrict grade 4 (widely avoided). SANHA mushbooh — derived from animal bones (pork/non-zabiha possible); avoid unless verified. One tier-1. (E542/zabiha grade 5 deliberately NOT staged: SANHA rules it mushbooh (doubtful), not haram, and the istihalah view holds processed bone pure — no tier-1 supports a flat 'haram' zabiha grade, so it is left pending rather than misgraded.)
